daily_report_items: Planet Labs quick check: the 31.88% four-week decline and 24.16 RSI strengthened the oversold alert, but Q2 changed contract-visibility, capex, mix and dilution inputs. PL is Unrated / Watch and allocation-ineligible pending dependent full review 01M26HW848ZZWZAZTZSYXFB7J2; no paper trade was created.

evidence.claim: From 2026-08-12 through 2026-09-10 the adjusted close declined 31.88% from USD 24.50 to USD 16.69. RSI 14 was 24.16, the close remained below the 20-day and 50-day moving averages, MACD remained below its signal, and the 2026-09-10 session declined another 3.08% without an abnormal-volume trigger.
evidence.source: PaperTrader deterministic price and technical projections

evidence.claim: The filing supports the bounded Q2 comparison: revenue and operating cash flow improved, while backlog and remaining performance obligations declined, capital expenditure increased, hardware revenue mix rose, and ATM issuance changed the per-share valuation inputs. Those changes make the August scenarios unsuitable as a current supportable valuation without full research.
evidence.source: Planet Labs PBC Q2 fiscal 2027 Form 10-Q

evidence.claim: The issuer reported stronger quarterly revenue, adjusted EBITDA and liquidity and maintained fiscal 2027 revenue guidance; this supports the operating thesis but does not resolve the changed valuation denominator, capital intensity or contract-conversion assumptions.
evidence.source: Planet Labs PBC Q2 fiscal 2027 financial results
